SELECT endpoint, quantileExact(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms, count() AS so_request FROM api_requests WHERE toYYYYMM(toTimeZone(ts, 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')) = 202407 GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
